meta.route: http://localhost:4200/ (main feed, tags route, 21 fixture posts)
meta.environment: Linux cloud VM (Ubuntu), Playwright Chromium headless-shell 151, MariaDB, Go API/CDNs, Node frontend dev server (node index.js)
meta.harness: speed-lab/harness/measure.mjs — per run: fresh browser (cold nav) then reload (warm); medians; settle 2500ms
meta.metrics: coldLoad/warmLoad = loadEventEnd; FCP/LCP via paint + largest-contentful-paint observers; feedPaint = first post card revealed with decoded thumbnail (cards animate from opacity:0 so LCP attributes to text, not thumbnails)

iterations.change: static-file ETag/Last-Modified + 304 + Cache-Control max-age=300 in soci-frontend dev server
iterations.tradeoff: dev assets up to 5min stale after edit; not immutable since filenames aren't content-hashed

iterations.change: defer non-feed components (post detail, comments, uploaders, channels, ledger, modals) to dynamic import after window load
iterations.tradeoff: deep links to non-feed routes upgrade their elements a beat after load on slow pipes

iterations.change: defer markdown-wasm loader script (was parser-blocking + eager 56KB wasm fetch)
iterations.tradeoff: markdown bodies render a tick later on slow pipes

iterations.change: modulepreload the eager module subtree (29 shell hints)
iterations.tradeoff: reverted; wash-to-regression on Slow 4G (bandwidth-bound HTTP/1.1, preload burst competes with CSS)

iterations.change: gzip compressible dev-server responses (JS/CSS/HTML/JSON/SVG/wasm incl. document)
iterations.tradeoff: ~10ms sync gzip CPU per cold load on localhost; keyed gzip cache is a follow-up

iterations.change: embed anonymous /posts payload path-keyed in feed shell HTML; client consumes once, live-fetch on any mismatch
iterations.tradeoff: cold loadEventEnd +215ms (thumbnails join the load window because content renders earlier); doc TTFB includes local server->API fetch

iterations.change: convert 8 parser-blocking page scripts to lazyload pattern (init at DOMContentLoaded)
iterations.tradeoff: page scripts init at DCL instead of during parse

iterations.change: load markdown-wasm on demand from soci-markdown-view (removes shell script + 56KB wasm from feed); fix post.js deep-link activation race
iterations.tradeoff: first markdown render on a route waits for loader+wasm fetch
